_about: Stop-lists of npm run check:lang (scripts/check-lang.ts). Each rule is a regular expression (flags: u, i unless 'cs' is set) over the text of one language and a hint of what to write instead. docs/glossary.md says which form is the canonical one. 'exceptions' lists the places where a hit is right (a quotation, the name of a source or of a building): unit + field + the matched text.

yo._about: ё in Russian: a word written without ё whose form with ё is written somewhere else in the texts is a hit (scripts/check-lang.ts builds the list from the texts). Words that are different words: pairs below.

ai_tells._about: Rules of npm run check:ai-tells (scripts/check-ai-tells.ts, docs/style-ai-tells.md). WARNINGS only, never an error: they point at habits of machine-written text, the cure is a concrete name, number or detail from the card's sources. Regular expressions (flags u, i) over the text of one language outside quotations. 'cliches' and 'constructions' hit anywhere; 'endings' only in the last sentence of a text; 'evaluative' are empty praise words (counted: each is a hit, and a share above thresholds.evaluative_share is one more); 'allow' lists the places where a hit is right (unit + optional field + the matched text + why).
